# Transportation Security Administration

> The TSA provides comprehensive airport security screening guidance, trusted traveler programs, and travel requirements for air transportation in the United States.

TSA.gov is the official resource for travelers seeking information about airport security procedures, identification requirements, baggage rules, and enrollment in expedited screening programs like TSA PreCheck. The site serves millions of passengers annually with up-to-date security protocols and digital identity verification options.

## Key Topics

- Airport Security Screening
- TSA PreCheck
- REAL ID
- Known Traveler Number
- Security Checkpoint
- Carry-on Baggage
- Checked Baggage
- Acceptable Identification
- Liquids Rule (3-1-1)
- Digital Identity
- TSA ConfirmID
- Prohibited Items
- Firearms Transport
- Identity Verification
- Traveler Redress

## Airport Security & Screening

- [Home | Transportation Security Administration](https://www.tsa.gov): TSA homepage with security screening, TSA PreCheck, REAL ID, and travel guidance
- [Security Screening | Transportation Security Administration](https://www.tsa.gov/travel/security-screening): Overview of TSA airport security procedures and screening measures
- [Emerging Technology | Transportation Security Administration](https://www.tsa.gov/travel/security-screening/emerging-technology): Information on TSA automated screening lanes and biometric technologies
- [Digital Identity and Facial Comparison Technology | Transportation Security Administration](https://www.tsa.gov/digital-id): Digital ID acceptance via Apple Wallet, Google Wallet, and facial comparison

## Identification & Travel Requirements

- [REAL ID | Transportation Security Administration](https://www.tsa.gov/realid): REAL ID Act requirements and federal identification standards for travel
- [Acceptable Identification at the TSA Checkpoint | Transportation Security Administration](https://www.tsa.gov/travel/security-screening/identification): Guide to acceptable forms of ID for TSA airport security checkpoints
- [TSA ConfirmID | Transportation Security Administration](https://www.tsa.gov/tsaconfirm-id): TSA ConfirmID alternative identity verification service for airport security

## TSA PreCheck & Trusted Traveler

- [TSA PreCheck® | Transportation Security Administration](https://www.tsa.gov/precheck): TSA PreCheck trusted traveler program enrollment and benefits overview
- [TSA PreCheck® Enrollment Centers | Transportation Security Administration](https://www.tsa.gov/precheck/enrollment-centers): Locator for TSA PreCheck enrollment centers through authorized providers
- [How to use TSA PreCheck® benefits | Transportation Security Administration](https://www.tsa.gov/precheck/benefits): How to use TSA PreCheck benefits and add known traveler number to bookings
- [TSA PreCheck® Renewals | Transportation Security Administration](https://www.tsa.gov/precheck/renew): Online renewal process for TSA PreCheck membership and known traveler number
- [Required Documents for TSA PreCheck® Application | Transportation Security Administration](https://www.tsa.gov/precheck/required-identification): Accepted identification documents for TSA PreCheck enrollment applications
- [TSA PreCheck® Checkpoint Schedule | Transportation Security Administration](https://www.tsa.gov/precheck/schedule): TSA PreCheck lane availability and schedules at airport checkpoints

## Baggage & Prohibited Items

- [What Can I Bring? | Transportation Security Administration](https://www.tsa.gov/travel/security-screening/whatcanibring/all): Comprehensive guide on permitted carry-on and checked baggage items
- [Liquids, Aerosols, and Gels Rule | Transportation Security Administration](https://www.tsa.gov/travel/security-screening/liquids-aerosols-gels-rule): TSA 3-1-1 liquids rule restrictions for carry-on baggage at security
- [Transporting Firearms and Ammunition | Transportation Security Administration](https://www.tsa.gov/travel/transporting-firearms-and-ammunition): Guidelines for properly packing and declaring firearms in checked baggage

## Traveler Support & Claims

- [DHS Traveler Redress Inquiry Program | Transportation Security Administration](https://www.tsa.gov/travel/security-screening/travel-redress-program): DHS TRIP program for travelers experiencing security screening difficulties
- [Claims | Transportation Security Administration](https://www.tsa.gov/travel/security-screening/claims): Process for filing claims for lost or damaged property at TSA checkpoints

## Travel Resources & Navigation

- [Travel | Transportation Security Administration](https://www.tsa.gov/travel): Main travel resource covering screening, TSA PreCheck, and baggage rules
- [A - Z Index | Transportation Security Administration](https://www.tsa.gov/a-zindex): Alphabetical index of TSA topics, programs, and security information
